propositions: Pandoc 3.6.1 silently corrupts content by escaping punctuation inside code spans, deleting HTML comments, and rewriting delimiters like --> when performing CommonMark-to-Jira conversion
A two-phase left-to-right lexer must lock complete {noformat} spans, backtick/tilde fences, and four-space-indented blocks before classification to preserve code and regex-dangerous content
Segmenting classification must recognize inline-Jira markup (bold, italic, link, color, monospace) and pass through only balanced, recognized spans with no CommonMark-only syntax or mixed markup
Post-render code-preservation check must require every source code fragment to appear verbatim in the output, else fall back to the original Markdown unit to mitigate unpredictable escaping

Corpus of 178 scrubbed bodies (29 code-arrow, 29 table, 120 prose) must achieve body ratio >=0.90 and character ratio >=0.95 with real pandoc 3.6.1 and exact preservation of HTML comments and table bytes

Missing pandoc availability or conversion/preservation failure must return the unit unchanged and log content-free fallback events (wiki_render_fallback with reason=pandoc_absent/conversion_failure/preservation_failure) without exposing body text
